descriptionHtml:
Onikuma CW917 Dual-Mode Wireless RGB White Gaming Mouse with 4800 DPI

Embrace the ultimate wireless freedom and smooth optical precision tracking with the Onikuma CW917 Dual-Mode Wireless RGB White Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this versatile PC hardware gaming peripheral is masterfully engineered for casual and competitive gamers, laptop users, and digital web managers across Egypt who demand cable-free desktop layout flexibility, instant switch actuation, and reliable power capacity. Backed by an official 1-year warranty for absolute peace of mind, this mouse features an ergonomic clean white shell structure designed to fit your hand naturally for fatigue-free operation during long gaming runs.

The highlight of this upgraded Onikuma CW917 variant is its efficient Dual-Mode connection framework, enabling you to toggle instantly between fluid high-speed 2.4GHz wireless tracking (via the included USB dongle) and a secure wired USB setup that safely charges the high-capacity internal rechargeable battery while you play. Shipped with a solid optical gaming sensor scaling up to 4800 DPI, it delivers highly responsive cross-screen navigation step customization. Armed with 6 functional action buttons and wrapped in dynamic multi-zone RGB backlight illumination modes, this sleek white hardware peripheral adds a striking modern aesthetic to any clean or custom white gaming battle station build setup.
